name: Akiyoshi Kenshirou
source:
Star Sign: Scorpio
Job: Salaryman at an IT company
Hobby: Collecting Spoons
Likes: Coffee, Cats
Dislikes: Scary Things

The protagonist's former boss.
He's kind but serious.
He's really knowledgeable about coffee and could talk for three days straight about it if he got excited.
